long_description:
Join Women’s Circle Chicago Monthly – In-Person & Virtual!

Experience heart-centered connection and empowerment at our Monthly Women’s Circle, held monthly on a Monday (Moon Day) in Chicago and online. Facilitated by Cindy Huston, founder of Yoga Body Elements, this sacred space supports women in setting personal and collective intentions, sharing authentically, and uplifting one another.

Each gathering includes a sample of Keith’s ceremonial cacao, space for each woman to speak, and a featured guest leader sharing a passion, project, or purpose. We close with a grounding circle to seal the energy of the evening.

Bring a mug for cacao and an open heart.

Medicine Songs & Sacred Connections as part of the cacao experience.

Following your cacao sharing, introduction of several traditional medicine songs, sharing a little about their intention and the role of song within ceremony, connection, and community.

Participants will be invited to learn and sing together, making this an interactive experience rather than simply listening to a performance. Through voice, rhythm, and collective singing, we create a space for connection, reflection, and honoring the gathering we have shared.

Meet guest lead Ketzal Cihuatl Diana

A spiritual woman, Mexican dancer, and student and practitioner of Traditional Mexican Medicine. Her path has been shaped by a lifelong connection to ancestral knowledge, ceremony,

healing, song, and the responsibility of learning from those who came before her.

Diana began her journey as a Mexican dancer at the age of 23. Over the years, she has had the privilege of

learning from teachers, elders, and practitioners who have contributed to her understanding of the Mexican

way of life. Among those who have influenced her path are Cuauhtémoc “Temok” Mosqueda García,

Estrella Newman, Guillermo Jaimes González Soto, Claudia Bravo, Alfonso in Michigan, Susana,

and Ambrosio.
